description: Record the return parcel as received: how many units of each line arrived and how many go back to stock. The return moves to received and stock rises by the restocked units only. Works on a requested or approved return. Every return line needs an entry - one left out is recorded as fully received and restocked. Money does not move - refund_return records the refund, complete_return closes a received return without a refund. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.

lines.description: One entry per return line; a line left out counts as fully received and fully restocked, so send receivedQuantity 0 for a line that did not arrive

itemId.description: The order item id of a line on this return

receivedQuantity.description: Units of this line that arrived

restockQuantity.description: Units going back to stock; at most receivedQuantity, 0 for damaged goods

orderId.description: The id of the order the return belongs to (from list_orders)

name: receive_return
title: Receive return
